text: UPDATE: The app developer informed me in reaction that it is an easy swipe to the right. I didn't find that in help. It would be great to have a short mention below: to complete a habit, swipe right --- Installed the app. Created a habit. Did the habit. No way to find out how to check done. So my reward for calming my mind with meditation was frustration to find how to fill in "done". After two times 10 minutes searching for the option, ending each time in the option: "change the habit", I decided this app is not working for me.
author: Annemart Berendse
developer_reply: Hi Annemart! We're sorry to learn about your unsatisfying experience with the app. Completing a habit or task is easy: you just need to swipe it right. We'll improve the onboarding part in this respect. Thank you for trying our app.
